from datetime import datetime

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Test parsing and validation of ISO 8601 duration syntax."""

    def test_missing_p_designator(self):
        """P designator is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "1Y")

    def test_just_p(self):
        """P alone without components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_just_pt(self):
        """PT without time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT")

    def test_p_with_unfinished_time(self):
        """P1DT without time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1DT")

    def test_whitespace_in_duration(self):
        """Whitespace anywhere in duration is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D T1H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), " P1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D ")

    def test_sign_on_component(self):
        """Sign on individual component (not at start) is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P-1D")

    def test_lowercase_designators(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "p1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1d")

    def test_duplicate_year_component(self):
        """Year component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1Y2Y")

    def test_duplicate_month_component(self):
        """Month component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_week_component(self):
        """Week component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W2W")

    def test_duplicate_day_component(self):
        """Day component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D2D")

    def test_duplicate_hour_component(self):
        """Hour component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1H2H")

    def test_duplicate_minute_component(self):
        """Minute component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_second_component(self):
        """Second component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1S2S")

    def test_components_out_of_order(self):
        """Components must appear in order: Y, M, W, D, T, H, M, S."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D1Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M1Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W1D")

    def test_weeks_with_other_date_components(self):
        """Week cannot be combined with other date components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2W3D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W1Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M1W")

    def test_weeks_with_time_components(self):
        """Week cannot be combined with other components even with time."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2WT1H")

    def test_no_digits_in_component(self):
        """Each component must have digits."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PY")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT H")

    def test_fraction_on_years(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on years."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1,5Y")

    def test_fraction_on_months(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5M")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1,5M")

    def test_fraction_not_on_last_component(self):
        """Only the last component may have a fractional part."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5D2H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1.5H2M")

    def test_fraction_missing_digits_before_separator(self):
        """Fraction must have at least one digit before separator."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT.5S")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT,5S")

    def test_fraction_missing_digits_after_separator(self):
        """Fraction must have at least one digit after separator."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1.S")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1,S")

    def test_multiple_decimal_separators(self):
        """Only one decimal separator is allowed."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1.5.5S")


class TestPositiveSingleComponents:
    """Test adding single positive components."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("years,start,expected", [
        (1, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2026, 1, 1)),
        (5, datetime(2000, 2, 29), datetime(2005, 2, 28)),
        (10, datetime(2015, 6, 15, 12, 30, 45), datetime(2025, 6, 15, 12, 30, 45)),
    ])
    def test_add_years(self, years, start, expected):
        """Test adding years."""
        assert add_duration(start, f"P{years}Y") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("months,start,expected", [
        (1, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2025, 2, 1)),
        (12, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2026, 1, 1)),
        (13, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2026, 2, 1)),
        (1, datetime(2024, 1, 31), datetime(2024, 2, 29)),
        (1, datetime(2025, 1, 31), datetime(2025, 2, 28)),
    ])
    def test_add_months(self, months, start, expected):
        """Test adding months."""
        assert add_duration(start, f"P{months}M") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("weeks,start,expected", [
        (1, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2025, 1, 8)),
        (2, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2025, 1, 15)),
        (52, datetime(2024, 1, 1), datetime(2024, 12, 30)),
    ])
    def test_add_weeks(self, weeks, start, expected):
        """Test adding weeks."""
        assert add_duration(start, f"P{weeks}W") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("days,start,expected", [
        (1, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2025, 1, 2)),
        (10, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2025, 1, 11)),
        (31, datetime(2025, 1, 1), datetime(2025, 2, 1)),
        (365, datetime(2024, 1, 1), datetime(2024, 12, 31)),
    ])
    def test_add_days(self, days, start, expected):
        """Test adding days."""
        assert add_duration(start, f"P{days}D") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("hours,start,expected", [
        (1, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0)),
        (24, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)),
        (25, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 2, 1, 0, 0)),
    ])
    def test_add_hours(self, hours, start, expected):
        """Test adding hours."""
        assert add_duration(start, f"PT{hours}H") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("minutes,start,expected", [
        (1, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0)),
        (60, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0)),
        (90, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 30, 0)),
    ])
    def test_add_minutes(self, minutes, start, expected):
        """Test adding minutes."""
        assert add_duration(start, f"PT{minutes}M") == expected

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("seconds,start,expected", [
        (1, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1)),
        (60, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0)),
        (3661, datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)),
    ])
    def test_add_seconds(self, seconds, start, expected):
        """Test adding seconds."""
        assert add_duration(start, f"PT{seconds}S") == expected


class TestNegativeSingleComponents:
    """Test subtracting single components (negative duration)."""

    def test_subtract_years(self):
        """Test subtracting years."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2026, 1, 1), "-P1Y") == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_subtract_months(self):
        """Test subtracting months."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 1), "-P1M") == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_subtract_weeks(self):
        """Test subtracting weeks."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "-P2W") == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_subtract_days(self):
        """Test subtracting days."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 10), "-P9D") == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_subtract_hours(self):
        """Test subtracting hours."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0), "-PT10H") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_subtract_minutes(self):
        """Test subtracting minutes."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 30, 0), "-PT30M") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_subtract_seconds(self):
        """Test subtracting seconds."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 30), "-PT30S") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_negative_with_leading_plus(self):
        """Leading + does not change the duration."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 10), "+P1D") == datetime(2025, 1, 11)


class TestFractionalComponents:
    """Test fractional components (last component only)."""

    def test_fractional_days_dot_separator(self):
        """Test fractional days with dot separator."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P0.5D") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_days_comma_separator(self):
        """Test fractional days with comma separator."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P0,5D") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_weeks(self):
        """Test fractional weeks."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P0.5W") == datetime(2025, 1, 4, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_hours(self):
        """Test fractional hours."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.5H") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 30, 0)

    def test_fractional_minutes(self):
        """Test fractional minutes."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.5M") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 30)

    def test_fractional_seconds(self):
        """Test fractional seconds."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.5S") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 500000)

    def test_fractional_seconds_microsecond_precision(self):
        """Test fractional seconds with microsecond precision."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0000005S")
        assert result.microsecond == 1  # rounded to nearest microsecond

    def test_multiple_fractional_digit_places(self):
        """Test fractions with multiple digit places."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1.25S") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 250000)

    def test_negative_fractional_component(self):
        """Test negative fractional component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 2, 12, 0, 0), "-P0.5D") == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)


class TestCombinedComponents:
    """Test combining multiple components in correct order."""

    def test_years_and_months_together(self):
        """Years and months are combined in one step."""
        # 2024-01-31 + P1M = 2024-02-29 (month-end handling)
        # Then adding years to that result
        assert add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M") == datetime(2025, 3, 31)

    def test_years_and_months_with_month_end_overflow(self):
        """Test month-end handling with years and months combined."""
        # 2024-01-31 + 13 months = 2025-02-28 (Feb has 28 days)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_years_months_and_days(self):
        """Test combining years, months, and days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1Y2M3D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 4)

    def test_years_months_days_and_time(self):
        """Test combining years, months, days, and time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6)

    def test_days_and_time(self):
        """Test combining days and time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30, 45), "P5DT3H15M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 6, 13, 45, 45)

    def test_weeks_and_time_invalid(self):
        """Weeks cannot be combined with other components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2WT1H")

    def test_negative_combined_components(self):
        """Test negative combined duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 31), "-P1M1D")
        # First go back 1 month: 2025-03-31 -> 2025-02-28
        # Then go back 1 day: 2025-02-28 -> 2025-02-27
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 27)

    def test_negative_months_then_days(self):
        """Test order of negative month and day application."""
        # 2024-03-01 - P1M1D
        # First go back 1 month: 2024-03-01 -> 2024-02-01
        # Then go back 1 day: 2024-02-01 -> 2024-01-31
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)


class TestMonthEndHandling:
    """Test special handling of month-end dates."""

    def test_jan_31_plus_one_month(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1 month should be Feb 28/29."""
        leap_year = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert leap_year == datetime(2024, 2, 29)
        
        non_leap_year = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert non_leap_year == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_march_31_minus_one_month(self):
        """Mar 31 - 1 month should be Feb 28/29."""
        leap_year = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert leap_year == datetime(2024, 2, 29)
        
        non_leap_year = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert non_leap_year == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_multiple_month_adjustments(self):
        """Test multiple month-end adjustments."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P2M")
        # Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 29
        # Feb 29 + 1 month = Mar 29
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 29)

    def test_month_end_with_leap_year(self):
        """Test that month-end handling respects leap years."""
        leap_2024 = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P12M")
        assert leap_2024 == datetime(2025, 2, 28)
        
        non_leap = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 28), "P12M")
        assert non_leap == datetime(2026, 2, 28)

    def test_multiple_months_reaching_month_end(self):
        """Test adding months that result in day-of-month overflow."""
        # Day 31 exists in Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Aug, Oct, Dec
        # It doesn't exist in Apr, Jun, Sep, Nov, Feb
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P3M")
        # Jan 31 -> Feb 28, Mar 28, Apr 28
        assert result == datetime(2025, 4, 28)


class TestLeapYears:
    """Test handling of leap years."""

    def test_add_year_to_leap_day(self):
        """Adding 1 year to Feb 29 goes to Feb 28 in non-leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_add_year_to_leap_day_reaching_leap_year(self):
        """Adding 4 years to Feb 29 goes to Feb 29 in next leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P4Y")
        assert result == datetime(2028, 2, 29)

    def test_leap_year_month_arithmetic(self):
        """Test that leap year month arithmetic is correct."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P13M")
        # Jan 31 + 13 months = Feb 29 (2025 is not leap year, so Feb 28)
        # Actually: Jan 31, 2024 + 13 months = Feb 29, 2025
        # 2025 is not a leap year, so it should be Feb 28
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)


class TestDatetimeRangeErrors:
    """Test error handling for datetime range boundaries."""

    def test_overflow_year_max(self):
        """Adding duration that exceeds max datetime should raise ValueError."""
        # datetime.max is year 9999
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(9999, 12, 31), "P1D")

    def test_underflow_year_min(self):
        """Subtracting duration that goes below min datetime should raise ValueError."""
        # datetime.min is year 1
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(1, 1, 1), "-P1D")

    def test_large_addition_near_max(self):
        """Test adding large duration near max datetime."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(9900, 1, 1), "P100Y")


class TestEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases and special scenarios."""

    def test_zero_prefix_components(self):
        """Components with leading zeros should work."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P01Y02M03D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 4)

    def test_large_component_values(self):
        """Test large component values."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P100Y")
        assert result == datetime(2125, 1, 1)

    def test_time_components_at_boundary(self):
        """Test time components that cause day transitions."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 23, 59, 59), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_negative_duration_month_boundary(self):
        """Test negative duration crossing month boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0), "-PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 31, 23, 59, 59)

    def test_fractional_component_rounding(self):
        """Test that fractional components are rounded to nearest microsecond."""
        # 0.5000001 seconds should round to 500000 microseconds (0.5 seconds)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.5000001S")
        assert result.microsecond == 500000

    def test_very_small_fractional_seconds(self):
        """Test very small fractional seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.000001S")
        assert result.microsecond == 1

    def test_time_preserves_microseconds(self):
        """Test that adding duration preserves existing microseconds correctly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 500000), "PT0.5S")
        assert result.microsecond == 1000000 % 1000000  # wraps to 0
        assert result.second == 1

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


# ============================================================================
# Syntax Validation Tests
# ============================================================================

class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Tests for valid and invalid ISO 8601 duration syntax."""

    def test_missing_p_prefix(self):
        """P prefix is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "1D")

    def test_just_p_no_components(self):
        """P alone without any components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_pt_without_components(self):
        """PT without time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT")

    def test_p_with_t_but_no_time_component(self):
        """P with T but no following time component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1DT")

    def test_lowercase_p_invalid(self):
        """Lowercase p is invalid; must be uppercase P."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "p1D")

    def test_lowercase_designators_invalid(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1y")

    def test_whitespace_invalid(self):
        """No whitespace anywhere."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P 1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1 D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D ")

    def test_sign_on_component_invalid(self):
        """Sign on a component is invalid; only on the whole duration."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P-1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P+1D")

    def test_wrong_component_order(self):
        """Components must appear in order: Y, M, W, D, T, H, M, S."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D1Y")  # D before Y
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M1D1M")  # M (months) after D
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1DT1H1D")  # D after T

    def test_duplicate_components(self):
        """Components cannot appear more than once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1Y1Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1H1H")

    def test_weeks_alone_valid(self):
        """Weeks alone are valid."""

class TestMicrosecondPrecision:
    """Tests for microsecond precision and rounding."""

    def test_fractional_seconds_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional seconds convert to microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.000001S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)

    def test_fractional_minutes_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional minutes convert to microseconds via seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.001M")
        # 0.001 minutes = 0.06 seconds = 60000 microseconds
        assert result.microsecond == 60000

    def test_fractional_hours_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional hours convert through minutes and seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0001H")
        # 0.0001 hours = 0.36 seconds = 360000 microseconds
        assert result.microsecond == 360000

    def test_fractional_day_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional days convert to microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), "P0.0001D")
        # 0.0001 days = 8.64 seconds = 8640000 microseconds, rounds to nearest
        # Actually: 0.0001 * 24 * 60 * 60 = 8.64 seconds
        assert result.second == 8 or result.second == 9

    def test_rounding_to_nearest_microsecond(self):
        """Results round to nearest microsecond."""
        # Very small fractional second
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0000001S")
        # This is 0.1 microseconds, should round to 0
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_rounding_fractional_half_up(self):
        """Rounding uses standard rounding (banker's rounding or round-half-up)."""
        # 0.5 microseconds should round to nearest
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0000005S")
        # 0.5 microseconds
        assert result.microsecond in [0, 1]  # Allow for different rounding modes

    def test_multiple_fractional_parts_sum_precisely(self):
        """Multiple fractional parts sum precisely."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.3S")
        result2 = add_duration(result, "PT0.3S")
        result3 = add_duration(result2, "PT0.4S")
        # 0.3 + 0.3 + 0.4 = 1.0 seconds exactly
        assert result3 == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0)

    def test_years_months_applied_before_days(self):
        """Years/months applied before days (affects month-end handling)."""
        # 2024-01-31 + P1M -> 2024-02-29 (month-end handling)
        # Then + 1 day would go to 2024-03-01
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1)

    def test_days_applied_before_time(self):
        """Days applied before time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0), "P1DT1H")
        # First: add 1 day -> 2025-01-02 00:00
        # Then: add 1 hour -> 2025-01-02 01:00
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 1, 0)

    def test_negative_months_then_days(self):
        """Negative: months applied before days."""
        # 2024-03-31 - 1 month -> 2024-02-29
        # Then - 1 day -> 2024-02-28
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 28)

    def test_complex_order_check(self):
        """Complex order verification."""
        # Start: 2024-03-31 10:00:00
        # +P1Y1M -> 2025-04-30 (day overflow to month-end)
        # +P2D -> 2025-05-02
        # +PT3H -> 2025-05-02 13:00:00
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31, 10, 0), "P1Y1M2DT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 5, 2, 13, 0)
